title: What happens if you stay awake for 3 days? Day 2

beats.text: Day two without sleep. Hour 36. Yesterday, you felt drunk. Today, it gets weird.
Your body starts to struggle. Inflammation rises in your blood, and your body temperature swings up and down.
Then comes the scariest part. Microsleeps.
Your brain switches off for a few seconds, sometimes up to half a minute, and you don't even notice.
Now imagine that while driving. At 60 miles an hour, five seconds with your eyes closed is longer than a football field.
Your mind gets foggy too. You lose track of time, get anxious, and the room starts to look a little off.
And on day three, your brain starts showing you things that aren't there. Follow Hoot for day three.
